Bindings for the Arduino Stepper library (Stepper.h).

Drives unipolar, bipolar, or five-phase stepper motors using 2, 4, or 5 control wires. Reference: https://github.com/arduino-libraries/Stepper Install via narduino libinstall --lib:"Stepper"
